story_title: David Spares Saul in the Cave
summary: While Saul hunted David, Saul walked into the very cave where David was hiding. David's men urged him to strike, but David only cut off a corner of Saul's robe and refused to harm God's anointed king.

story_reel.narration: While hunting for David, Saul went into a cave to rest. He didn't know that David and his men were hiding way in the back of that very same cave! David's men whispered, 'This is the day! God has given your enemy into your hands. Do whatever you want to him!' David crept forward quietly in the dark. But instead of hurting Saul, he secretly cut off a small corner of Saul's robe. Afterward, David's heart troubled him, even for doing that. He said to his men, 'Yahweh forbid that I should do anything to harm the king, God's anointed one.' And he didn't let his men attack Saul. When Saul left the cave, David followed him out and called, 'My lord the king!' Saul turned around. David bowed down and held up the piece of robe. 'Look! I cut off the corner of your robe, but I didn't hurt you. I haven't done anything wrong to you, but you're hunting me. May Yahweh judge between us. But I won't lift my hand against you.' Saul cried out loud. 'You are more righteous than I am. You've repaid me with good, but I've repaid you with evil.' During this time, David wrote: 'My heart is steadfast, God. I will sing praises!'

memory_verse.text: My heart is steadfast, God. My heart is steadfast. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises.

identity_focus.core_truth: I can keep a steady heart that worships Yahweh, even when I'm treated unfairly.
identity_focus.reflection_prompt: David could have gotten revenge, but he chose to trust God instead, and then he wrote a song. When you're treated unfairly, how could you worship God instead of getting even?
reflection_choices: Draw how I feel and give it to God

quiz.question: What did David cut off in the cave?
quiz.explanation: David arose and cut off the skirt of Saul's robe secretly.

quiz.question: Why wouldn't David harm Saul?
quiz.explanation: David said, 'Yahweh forbid that I should do this thing to my lord, Yahweh's anointed.'

quiz.question: What did Saul say to David?
options: 'You are more righteous than I am.'
quiz.explanation: Saul said to David, 'You are more righteous than I; for you have done good to me.'

micro_prayer.text: Yahweh, keep my heart steady. When I'm treated unfairly, help me trust You to make things right, and help me sing praises to You instead of getting even. Amen.

companion.message: My men thought I was crazy for not striking. But God had made Saul king, and I trusted God to work it out. Then I sang about it!

review.notes: Saul's reason for entering the cave (24:3, 'to relieve himself') is softened to 'to rest.' Linking Psalm 57 follows its superscription. Confirm.
